Post 1
📈 ASX 200 closed August at 9,092.30, up 1.61% for the month — just 2.20% below its 52-week high. A quiet grind higher, but the spread between winners and losers underneath was anything but quiet. #ASX200 #ausbiz

Post 2
Health Care surged 21.73% in August, Materials added 15.41%, IT gained 10.55%. On the other side, Financials dropped 7.70% and Consumer Discretionary fell 7.15%. The growth-defensive split was the sharpest sector divergence of 2026. #ASX #healthcare #materials

Post 3
⛏️ Pantoro Gold led the ASX 200 on Friday, up 5.88%, with Vulcan Energy close behind at 5.04%. Both moves signal renewed conviction in hard assets as the month closed out. #ASX #gold #mining

Post 4
🔺 Materials up 15.41% and Health Care up 21.73% drove August's index gains while rate-sensitive Financials shed 7.70% and A-REITs fell 6.88% — a clear signal markets priced in higher-for-longer rates. #RBA #ausbiz #ASX

Post 5
ASX 200 sits 2.20% from its 52-week high. A break above could trigger momentum buying. Risk: Financials down 7.70% drag if rate pressure persists. Does Materials strength carry the index to a new high in September, or do banks pull it back? #ASX200 #ausbiz
